author: Danielstjohn
visual_review: Upright plant with pot rim and much clearer leaf silhouettes, serrations and visible branches. Outdoor flag/fence/vegetation background; pot bottom is cropped and some foliage overlaps. Cultivar and cannabinoid profile are not established by the source.

author: Felix Brönnimann
review_title: Rejected as the primary whole-plant image
visual_review: High-resolution photograph, but much of the frame is a person, with cropped plants, occlusion and out-of-focus foreground. Retained as context only, not selected as a whole-plant replacement.

author: Plantlady223
visual_review: Two living plants in containers, dense overlapping foliage and a reflective indoor background. Useful harder segmentation image. Lower leaves are shaded; this is a tent photograph, not evidence of a specific commercial factory layout. Cultivar is unknown.
